$comment: Generator structured-output schema. answer_text is required; the six claim fields are nullable and the generator fills only the ones it actually claimed in answer_text. Every response is validated against this schema by the runner; validation failure halts the run rather than coerces (Haiku-as-generator has a non-zero rate of malformed output, and silent coercion would corrupt the analysis).
title: Generator output

answer_text.description: The natural-language answer the generator produced. Required.

claimed_objective.description: OBJ. The numerical objective value the answer asserted (Solomon-native units, same as the payload's units.objective). Null if the answer made no objective claim.

claimed_feasible.description: PLAN_VALIDITY. Whether the answer asserted the plan is feasible. Null if the answer made no feasibility claim.

claimed_route_count.description: STRUCT. The number of routes / trucks / vehicles the answer asserted. Null if the answer made no count claim.

claimed_route_membership.description: STRUCT. List of {route_idx, customer_ids} pairs the answer asserted (a customer-on-route claim or a route-contains-customers claim). Null if the answer made no membership claim.

claimed_late_customers.description: SCHEDULE. Customer IDs the answer asserted were late. Empty array means the answer asserted nobody is late; null means the answer made no lateness claim at all.

claimed_customer_timings.description: SCHEDULE. List of (customer_id, stated arrival or start-service time) pairs the answer asserted. Times in Solomon-native units, same as the payload's units.time. Null if the answer made no per-customer timing claim.
